messages:
margo-cs: Heads-up — CardiaFlow hit regional throttles during a live partner demo. They requested a short-lived throughput bump + IP allowlist for EU and APAC while onboarding finishes. Case 846700 opened. Need quick triage.

liam-net: What QPS and CIDRs? Which edges do they want routed to?

margo-cs: Case 846700 details: EU -> 3400 qps (baseline ~950), APAC -> 1300 qps (baseline ~410). Window: 36h starting now, auto-revoke after. Egress CIDRs provided: 23.88.0.0/16 and 45.60.96.0/19. They prefer eu-west + apac-sg edges.

liam-net: I can add ephemeral L7 allowlist entries with TTL=129600s (36h). Tagging 'customer:cardiaflow'. No peering now. Applying in ~2m.

emma-eng: Which route/model? For stability set max_concurrency=8, cap max_tokens=400, enable prefix caching and warm KV cache for their demo prompts. Recommend fallback to redwood/llama-2-13b-chat-q4 if the 70b is constrained.

margo-cs: Route: cf-assistant-prod -> redwood/llama-2-70b-chat-q4. Customer accepts fallback to redwood/llama-2-13b-chat-q4. Also asked we capture per-region request counts and any errors during the window.

cs-bot: Ticket 846700-ephemeral-allowlist created by margo-cs. Assigned: liam-net. SLA: 3h.

liam-net: Applying L7 rules now. Plan: ephemeral rule TTL=129600, map CIDRs to eu-west/apac-sg pools, tag 'ephemeral:cardiaflow-846700'. Rolling apply ~3m.

nate-ops: After apply please run a smoke test and paste a curl we can share with the customer. Use chat endpoint.

liam-net: Done — rules applied and tagged. Verified 200 from 23.88.12.9 hitting eu-west. Auto-revoke scheduled.

emma-eng: Ran a small synthetic pilot at representative load: p50 86ms, p95 360ms. Enabled prefix caching and warmed KV. Set runtime fallback to 13b if queueing >4%. Will monitor p99.

nate-ops: Pasted smoke curl to case and to customer. Example we used:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
 -d '{"route":"cf-assistant-prod","input":"health check","max_tokens":10}'
```

sara-sales: Renewal note — CardiaFlow renewal in 23 days. This demo is high impact for expansion. I added Renewal Watch to case 846700 and CC'd AE. Please capture any post-demo feedback in the case.

margo-cs: Thanks team :raised_hands: Notifying CardiaFlow that the bump + allowlist are live and scheduling a 20-min enablement huddle with their SRE. Will update case with post-demo notes.
